<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Kobold Cavern Mage](/NPCs.aspx?ID=3074)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Kobold cavern mages are born more than trained, hatching from eggs that absorbed particularly large amounts of primal earth energy. Although there are many elementals and even natural terrain features that can give rise to cavern mages, most are related to the cavern-dwelling earth nymphs known as [lampads](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1249). These lonely and capricious fey are as enthusiastic to receive the company of a kobold tribe as the kobolds are for the protection they receive in return.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 16

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 11
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 2">[Kobold Cavern Mage](/NPCs.aspx?ID=3074)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Small" />
<trait label="Humanoid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=628" />
<trait label="Kobold" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=759" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 211

**Perception** +5; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Fey](/Languages.aspx?ID=119), [Petran](/Languages.aspx?ID=109), [Sakvroth](/Languages.aspx?ID=118)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +6, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +8, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +8, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +8, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +5, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +6

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +2

**Dex** +2

**Con** -1

**Int** +0

**Wis** +1

**Cha** +4
</row>

**Items**
[light hammer](/Equipment.aspx?ID=24)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 16 

**Fort** +5 

**Ref** +6 

**Will** +7 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 20

</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
light hammer +6 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)),
**Damage** 1d6+2 bludgeoning

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
claw +6 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179)),
**Damage** 1d6+2 slashing

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
light hammer +6 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [thrown 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195)),
**Damage** 1d6+2 bludgeoning

**Primal Spontaneous Spells** DC 18
- **Cantrips (1st)**
[Caustic Blast](/Spells.aspx?ID=1461), [Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), [Figment](/Spells.aspx?ID=1528), [Know the Way](/Spells.aspx?ID=1582), [Tangle Vine](/Spells.aspx?ID=1713)
- **1st**
[Fleet Step](/Spells.aspx?ID=122), [Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148), [Pummeling Rubble](/Spells.aspx?ID=708), [Runic Weapon](/Spells.aspx?ID=1658) (4 slots)

**Inspiring Display** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [Emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [Linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=101), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) **Requirements** The cavern mage's previous action was to Cast a Spell; **Effect** The cavern mage uses their magical display to inspire another kobold within 30 feet. That kobold gains 4 temporary Hit Points that last until the start of the cavern mage's next turn.

**Scamper** <actions string="Single Action" />  **Requirements** The cavern mage is adjacent to at least one enemy; **Effect** The cavern mage Strides up to their Speed plus 5 feet and gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by this movement. They must end this movement in a space that's not adjacent to any enemy.

</column>
